# Catppuccin cursors, Mocha Teal

`catppuccin-mocha-teal-cursors.zip` is the unmodified release asset of
[catppuccin/cursors](https://github.com/catppuccin/cursors) v2.0.0, based on
Volantes Cursors. It is distributed under the GNU GPL v2 (`LICENSE` inside the
archive), as a separate work alongside CachyOS Teal.
